# The changed paths that run the Wannier tier-2 job (ci.yml, wannier-tier2).
#
# One extended regular expression per line, matched from the start of a
# repository-relative path; blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
#
# Anything that feeds a Wannier model: the interpolator itself, the
# ITERATOR that hands it the quantum system, the k-space geometry it
# is built on, the Fermi energy the frozen window is measured against,
# the command and workflow that drive it, the input schema that
# configures it, the examples it runs, and the tests themselves.
#
# The iterator is here because the capture reads its quantum-system
# snapshot: a downcast against the wrong one of its two systems made
# every ultrasoft and PAW capture unreachable, and a change to that
# snapshot would have matched nothing in this list.
#
# The layer-0 dense algebra and the two q3.io model packages are here
# because every chain runs through them: the kernels multiply and
# diagonalise with the first, and the ladder writes each evaluation's
# block and reads each results file through the second.
#
# The eigensolver and the NSCF flavor are here because they produce the
# eigenvectors the capture reads. Halving Davidson's default working
# basis made a single NSCF pass miss eigenvalues by tens of meV while
# every residual test passed; these chains were the only thing that
# noticed, and the change matched nothing in this list.
